description: Triage eval. 'states' are code states applied to a fresh export of HEAD (each edit must match exactly once). 'runs' are the Playwright runs that produced the real failures in golden.json (npm run eval:triage:build). 'gate' is what npm run eval:triage enforces.

unmarked.description: Every knownBug() marker removed from the specs, so catalogued defects fail as unexplained regressions.

uncatalogued.description: Unmarked, and SD-104 and SD-203 removed from the catalogue and the app model: real defects nobody has recorded yet.

edits.find: - SD-203: Remove throws `Error: Failed to remove item from cart.` and keeps the item.

tax-rate.description: Test bug: the tax rate the tests derive totals from is wrong.

stale-badge.description: Test bug: the header component looks for the cart badge under a test id the app does not use.

cart-title.description: Test bug: the expected cart page title in the test data is wrong.

backpack-price.description: Test bug: the catalogue price of the backpack in the test data is wrong.

runs.name: uncatalogued
runs.grep: removes a product on the inventory page
runs.decidingFact: The test expects Remove to work for this persona, the app does not do it, and there is no catalogue entry for the defect.

runs.name: tax-rate
runs.decidingFact: TAX_RATE in src/utils/pricing.ts is 0.07, but the app model (and the constant's own comment) says tax is 8%.

runs.name: stale-badge
runs.decidingFact: The header component looks for test id shopping-cart-count; the app model gives the badge as shopping-cart-badge, and the page snapshot shows the badge.

runs.name: stale-badge-personas
runs.grep: adds Sauce Labs Backpack to the cart
runs.decidingFact: The failing product (Backpack) is one this persona can add (SD-103 and SD-202 cover only Bolt T-Shirt, Fleece Jacket and Red T-Shirt), and the header component looks for test id shopping-cart-count instead of the app model's shopping-cart-badge.

runs.name: cart-title
runs.decidingFact: PAGE_TITLES.cart in src/data/messages.ts is 'Your Basket'; the app (and the app model) shows 'Your Cart'.

runs.name: backpack-price
runs.decidingFact: The backpack's priceCents in src/data/products.ts is 2899; the app (and the app model's catalogue) shows $29.99.

runs.name: unreachable-host
runs.decidingFact: The host does not resolve (net::ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED): the run never reached the app.

runs.name: expired-session
runs.decidingFact: A logged-in page never showed its ready marker although the marker's test id is valid, so the page did not load as a logged-in session: an expired or missing .auth/ session, refreshed by running the setup project.
